metadata.meaning: Every seat VoteGA tracks. A districted seat is its set of census blocks: its id carries the map that FIRST drew it (`plan`) and is never renamed; `redrawnBy` names the map that replaced it, null while in force. A district a later map left untouched keeps its seat. Holders are not here (Phase 2).
sources: Georgia Legislative and Congressional Reapportionment Office block-equivalency files (compared in scripts/data/seat-plan-comparison.json)
